mapper.sql: pk_id, id, tenant_id, people_id, org_id, prescription_group_id, source, drug_name, usage_method, frequency, dose_amount, dose_unit, start_date, stop_date, timing_note, course_days, time_morning, time_noon, time_evening, time_bedtime, has_adverse_reaction, remark, status, created_by_staff_id, updated_by_staff_id, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO people_medication( id, tenant_id, people_id, org_id, prescription_group_id, source, drug_name, usage_method, frequency, dose_amount, dose_unit, start_date, stop_date, timing_note, course_days, time_morning, time_noon, time_evening, time_bedtime, has_adverse_reaction, remark, status, created_by_staff_id, updated_by_staff_id, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{peopleId}, #{orgId}, #{prescriptionGroupId}, #{source}, #{drugName}, #{usageMethod}, #{frequency}, #{doseAmount}, #{doseUnit}, #{startDate}, #{stopDate}, #{timingNote}, #{courseDays}, #{timeMorning}, #{timeNoon}, #{timeEvening}, #{timeBedtime}, #{hasAdverseReaction}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{createdByStaffId}, #{updatedByStaffId}, #{isDeleted}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified}, #{gmtDeleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE people_medication SET org_id = #{orgId}, prescription_group_id = #{prescriptionGroupId}, source = #{source}, drug_name = #{drugName}, usage_method = #{usageMethod}, frequency = #{frequency}, dose_amount = #{doseAmount}, dose_unit = #{doseUnit}, start_date = #{startDate}, stop_date = #{stopDate}, timing_note = #{timingNote}, course_days = #{courseDays}, time_morning = #{timeMorning}, time_noon = #{timeNoon}, time_evening = #{timeEvening}, time_bedtime = #{timeBedtime}, has_adverse_reaction = #{hasAdverseReaction}, remark = #{remark}, status = #{status}, updated_by_staff_id = #{updatedByStaffId}, gmt_modified = #{gmtModified} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE people_medication SET is_deleted = 1, updated_by_staff_id = #{staffId}, gmt_deleted = NOW(), gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM people_medication WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE people_medication SET status = 'STOPPED', gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND id IN ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT m.id FROM people_medication m INNER JOIN tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( (m.stop_date IS NOT NULL AND m.stop_date < #{today}) OR ( m.stop_date IS NULL AND m.course_days IS NOT NULL AND m.course_days > 0 AND m.start_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE_ADD(m.start_date, INTERVAL (m.course_days - 1) DAY) < #{today} ) ) LIMIT #{limit} ) due_ids )
